answer_text: IPsec sites: the default BFD values are 1000 ms transmit, 1000 ms receive, with a multiplier of 5. BFD is supported for IPsec and Cloud Interconnect sites; timers are negotiated when a BFD session is established, and Cato initiates BFD by default if there is at least one BFD-enabled active peer. The KB does not specify a separate default timer for Cloud Interconnect sites. After changing BFD timers, the KB only notes that timers are negotiated during BFD session establishment and does not specify a required action to apply new timer settings.
